title: eth.ai
tagline: A gaia node consisting of Qwen model trained on Ethereum documentation
description: This project contains a gaia node that acquires an LLM of the Qwen-2.5-3b model and is trained on the Ethereum Knowledge base. We first traversed the entire documentation provided on the Ethereum.org website and then chunked it well to create a set of Questions and answers. These questions vary as per their topics
how_its_made: The project involves the creation of a Gaia node that utilizes the Qwen-2.5-3b language model, specifically trained on an extensive knowledge base derived from Ethereum-related documentation. The process begins with a comprehensive traversal of the documentation available on the Ethereum.org website, which covers various aspects of the Ethereum ecosystem.
